services.name: Bioluminescence Boat Tour
services.desc: Join us on a Bioluminescence Boat Tour on the waters of Cocoa Beach, Cape Canaveral, near Orlando light up like magic! Come join us on a once-in-a-lifetime Bioluminescence Boat Tour where we GUARANTEE you see bioluminescence or you don’t pay! Our private bioluminescence boat tour takes you through the beautiful waters of Cocoa Beach, Cape Canaveral, and Port Canaveral near Orlando-one of only a handful of places in the world where you can witness this incredible natural phenomenon. Bioluminescence is the production and emission of light by living organisms. services.name: River Fishing
services.desc: Our expert captains cover all the world class inshore and nearshore fishing available. Fin & Fly offers inshore fishing charters in Cocoa Beach, Cape Canaveral, Titusville, and Orlando. River fishing charters are an amazing experience for all levels of angler, and the calm waters of our rivers and inshore waters are a perfect way to introduce children to the joys of fishing. The rich rivers and waterways throughout Florida’s Space Coast are home to world class river fishing for Redfish, Snook, Tarpon, Black Drum, Speckled Sea Trout and more! services.name: Private Dolphin Tour
services.desc: Enjoy a relaxing private boat tour and see dolphins, manatees, and coastal wildlife on the beautiful waters of Florida’s Space Coast. Looking for the best private dolphin tours in Cocoa Beach? Fin & Fly Charters offers exclusive dolphin watching boat tours where your group has the entire boat to yourselves. Our private tours allow you to experience Florida’s wildlife without crowds while cruising the beautiful waterways around Cocoa Beach and Cape Canaveral. During your tour, you’ll search for playful bottlenose dolphins that regularly swim through these waters. Guests often see dolphins swimming alongside the boat, feeding in the shallows, or traveling through the lagoon in small pods.
